text:
lee: FYI scheduling a multi-AZ failover dry-run this Wed 04:00-04:20 UTC. Scope: simulate cross-AZ failure for a single customer-facing shard (shard-08) and validate autoscaling + routing fallback chain. Goal is to measure p95/p99 impact and ensure no reserved Dedicated pools are affected.

nora: Which shard exactly and will we shift traffic gradually?

lee: shard-08. We'll shift 10% -> 50% -> 0% in three steps, pausing 5m between steps for metrics. Non-prod Dedicated pools used for full drains; prod only targeted via routing rules (no drains).

devin: Alerting changes for the window? want to avoid paging for expected noise.

lee: Plan: silence latency-noise and lower noise for autopager for 20m; keep error-rate and availability pages active. Temporary p99 page threshold set to 7s for the window. Ops to apply silences 10m prior.

nora: Runbook link? I want to check kv warmup and model-cache steps.

lee: Runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/rehearsals/multi-az-dryrun-2102. Key warmup call (run 10m before canary): curl -s -X POST https://admin/kv/warmup -d '{"prefixes":["/models/primary/","/kv/hot/"],"threads":12,"duration_sec":180}'

devin: Rollback plan?

lee: Quick rollback: flip feature-flag routing.failover_enabled=false for the shard, revert any pool drains, run kv-prefill on baseline. Commands in runbook.

sre-bot: Reminder scheduled: multi-AZ dry-run in 24h. Will ping 60m before.

nora: One ask: please tag long-running eval jobs as exclude-from-dryrun before window.

lee: Added to preflight checklist. Oncall for window: devin primary, nora backup. Please ACK if no blockers. :thumbsup:

devin: ack

nora: ack

lee: Will post post-run TL;DR with p95/p99, error-rate, and token-cost delta. Thread pinned to channel by lee.
